$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

prune.enabled.does: Runs the automatic disk prune; the free-space check at the start of a run stays.

prune.minFreeGb.does: The free disk space a run needs to start or go on (`null`: no check).

prune.buildDirs.does: Build folders removed from idle pipeline worktrees.

prune.buildDirNames.does: Git-ignored folder names removed from idle pipeline worktrees.

prune.slotMaxGb.does: Leftovers of a stack copy larger than this may be cleaned up (`null`: no size cap).

prune.worktreeDays.does: A ticket's worktree is removed this long after its PR merged or closed (`null`: never).

prune.keepInstalls.does: The newest engine installs that are always kept.

prune.installRepos.does: Other repositories on this machine whose pinned engine installs are kept.

prune.analysisCacheDays.does: Analysis tools and rule sources unused this long are removed from the machine's cache.

prune.analysisReports.does: Analysis reports beyond the newest this many commits are removed.

prune.analysisBaseDays.does: Analysis merge-base caches unused this long are removed.

prune.afterDelivery.does: Alpha: removes what a delivered run made on this machine once the delivery remote confirms it.

prune.keepLocal.does: Keeps what a delivered run made, for debugging (with `afterDelivery` on).

e2e.dir.does: The folder of the repository's e2e tests, where `factory render` keeps the shared e2e fixtures.

prune.idleSec.does: Files a run touched more recently than this are never cleaned up.

prune.slotMaxAgeSec.does: Leftovers of a stack copy older than this may be cleaned up.

prune.imageMinAgeSec.does: Old app images younger than this are kept.
